title: Keep the RustSec audit job compatible with the Rust 1.89 MSRV
description: Keep the RustSec audit job compatible with the Rust 1.89 MSRV
no_spec_change_rationale: This changes only CI tool installation wiring; the security audit policy and SpecSync product contract remain unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: The audit job installs cargo-audit 0.22.2 with its lockfile under Rust 1.89
executes cargo audit without weakening advisory checks
and the required CI gate passes.
